newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek shares drift lower in light volume.
newsitem.headline: Greek shares drift lower in light volume.

text.p: Greek shares pared early gains to close lower on Monday in light volume with the benchmark index trading narrowly before shedding 0.29 percent.
"Equities remain hostage to thin trading volume resulting in dull sessions with slight price fluctuations from current levels," said Nick Stathopoulos, broker at Devletoglou Securities.
"There is very limited downside risk and prospects for the medium- to long-term are good," he added. "But at the same time the index cannot break out to the upside in the near-term."
Weekend financial press reports see July CPI inflation easing to 5.4 percent from June's 5.5 percent. An offical announcement is expected on Friday.
"We have come a long way to an inflation rate of around 5.5 percent and this to a large extent is already incorporated into stock prices," Stathopoulos said.
The Athens general index slipped 0.29 percent or 4.6 points to 1,586.85 from Friday's 1,591.45 close, trading narrowly between 1,584 and 1,597 points.
Industrials and banks were down 0.04 and 0.44 percent respectively.
Turnover eased to 7.5 billion drachmas on volume of 2.4 million shares.
Trading included a block of 200,000 preference shares of Papastratos which changed hands at 4,710 drachmas.
Decliners beat advancers 105 to 85 with 34 shares unchanged on 224 traded.
OTE telecom Global Depository Shares (GDS) were quoted on London's SEAQ International market at $10.60-$10.95. Two GDSs make up one share of OTE.
